layoutDirective: Create one professional photorealistic full-body character casting reference on a single square canvas. Show exactly three clearly separated equal-scale views of the same adult character side by side in one horizontal row, ordered left to right: front view facing directly toward the camera, exact side profile facing toward the viewer right, and back view facing directly away from the camera. In the exact side profile, the face, nose, chest, hips, knees, and toes all point toward the viewer right; keep the head aligned with the torso and never turn it toward the camera or opposite the body. Use a neutral upright anatomical reference stance in every view: feet grounded at a natural hip-width distance, knees straight but not locked, pelvis and shoulders level, spine naturally aligned, arms relaxed vertically beside the torso, hands open with fingers naturally together, and no fashion posing. Show every complete head-to-feet figure at the same scale with generous clear margin above the hair, below the feet, and beside each silhouette. Never crop the head, hair, shoulders, elbows, hands, fingers, legs, or feet. Keep the same recognizable face, hair, skin tone, height relationship, body shape, and selected anatomical proportions in all three views without averaging or normalizing the body. Preserve realistic adult fashion-model proportions with a naturally proportioned head-to-body relationship of approximately 1:7.5 to 1:8, a full-length torso, and naturally long legs. Never enlarge the head or face, shorten the torso, compress the legs, or introduce childlike, doll-like, chibi, caricature, or stylized character proportions. Use a level eye-height camera placed far enough away to include all three complete figures, an 85 to 105mm full-frame-equivalent perspective, minimal lens distortion, even neutral studio illumination, soft grounded contact shadows, and a seamless matte light warm-gray studio background with clear tonal separation from skin and clothing.
anatomicalDirectionDirective: Treat each view as one continuous anatomically coherent person from crown to toes; never rotate, mirror, or splice the lower body independently from the torso. In the front view, the face, sternum, navel, pelvis, kneecaps, ankles, and toes all face directly toward the camera. In the exact side profile, the face, sternum, navel, pelvis, knees, ankles, heels, and toes all face viewer right on one shared side axis. In the back view, the back of the head, shoulder blades, spine, pelvis, backs of both knees, heels, and backs of both feet all face directly away from the camera; show rear-facing heels and foot backs, never front-facing toes or a side-facing foot. Preserve anatomically consistent left and right limbs in every figure. Never combine a front-facing leg set with a back-facing torso, reverse the feet beneath the pelvis, twist knees opposite the hips, or mix front, side, and back anatomy within one silhouette.

uniformDirectives.female: Dress the adult female character in an opaque matte medium-gray unbranded silhouette-reading casting outfit: a fitted short-sleeve athletic top with a deep rounded scoop neckline ending securely above the cleavage line, the top ending cleanly at the natural waist, and matching fitted high-rise short upper-thigh athletic shorts with a short inseam and complete seat and groin coverage. Print a subtle white contour grid directly on the gray fabric using thin evenly spaced horizontal and vertical lines. The grid must follow the fabric surface and curve naturally over the body in every view without numbers, labels, symbols, or measurement marks. A narrow natural midriff gap may remain visible only when created by the waist-length top. The outfit must follow the selected natural anatomy without compression, padding, lifting, reshaping, concealment, or flattening of the upper torso, waist, hips, or seat. Keep the coverage professional and non-sexualized; never use underwear, lingerie, swimwear, transparent fabric, exposed cleavage, high-cut leg openings, thong-like cuts, or decorative styling.

outputDirective: The result must look like a real high-resolution studio photograph of a real adult person, with natural skin texture, individual hair strands, realistic fabric tension, subtle photographic grain, and physically plausible shadows. It must not look like AI art, CGI, 3D rendering, illustration, a mannequin, or a beauty-retouched composite. Produce an unlabeled image only: no text, captions, words, letters, view titles, arrows, numbers, height or weight data, measurement lines, rulers, diagrams, borders, dividers, logos, watermark, props, dramatic gestures, extra people, duplicate views, inset panels, isolated foot close-up, or cropped limbs. Bare feet are allowed and must appear naturally within each complete full-body view; do not add shoes unless explicitly required by an approved casting policy.
